decision: Prepare and verify exact host/registry/request inputs where evidence exists, without dispatch or fit/readiness assertion.
steps: Project existing T55 source/image/geometry and hash-bound inspection records into the T53 strict registry and host fields; do not author invented verification.
Use exact selected raw/static source records and saved-proposal identities for audits. Preserve D1/D2 exposure and target/context boundaries.
Bind T75 source-specific HR012 instructions and typed diagnostics into S1/S2 inputs, and record exact named-feedback post-response checks.
Derive per-unit reply schemas, prompt/code/resource/body identities and immutable request bytes for available units only; retain explicit missing rows for S3/S4.
Validate known inputs with existing host/projection checks. Unavailable genuine fit/producer/resources stay missing; do not build or dispatch FrozenJobs by faking token counts.
